leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a React component with an expensive computation function
Apply the useMemo hook to cache the result of an expensive calculation
Configure useMemo dependencies to control when recomputation occurs
Implement a comparison between memoized and non-memoized rendering behavior
Manipulate component state to trigger re-renders and observe performance differences
Integrate useMemo with existing state and props to optimize component performance
Construct a practical example demonstrating when useMemo provides tangible benefits
